description: This Java interface defines configuration settings related to delete operations in the 'thingsearch' service, including methods for checking if delete events or namespaces are enabled, and an enum for configuration values with defaults and paths.

classes.name: DeleteConfig
classes.description: Interface providing methods for delete configuration options, such as delete event and namespace flags, and an inner enum 'DeleteConfigValue' for configuration keys with default values and paths.

classes.name: DeleteConfig.DeleteConfigValue
classes.description: Enum implementing KnownConfigValue, representing specific configuration keys ('event' and 'namespace') along with their default values and configuration paths.

methods.name: isDeleteEvent
methods.description: Method to determine whether delete events are enabled.

methods.name: isDeleteNamespace
methods.description: Method to determine whether delete namespace operations are enabled.
